trigger.definition: CREATE TRIGGER close_pack_exports_retain_canonical_trigger BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.close_pack_exports FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION close_pack_exports_retain_canonical()

constraint.definition: CHECK (((("canonicalContent" IS NULL) AND ("canonicalContentSha256" IS NULL) AND ("exportRequestHash" IS NULL)) OR (("canonicalContent" IS NOT NULL) AND (length("canonicalContent") > 0) AND ("canonicalContentSha256" IS NOT NULL) AND ("canonicalContentSha256" ~ '^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$'::text) AND ("exportRequestHash" IS NOT NULL) AND ("exportRequestHash" ~ '^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$'::text) AND ("canonicalContentSha256" = ('sha256:'::text || encode(sha256(convert_to("canonicalContent", 'UTF8'::name)), 'hex'::text))))))
